scope: Static read-only review of scripts/nanhai_plus_native_graph_v1.py; no runner, graph, container, device, or Bridge execution.
positive_findings: Line 57 fixes the requested --make-mode --soong-only --skip-ninja --skip-soong-tests libc libm libdl linker argv; these flags are valid in R4 ui/build/config.go:987-1013.
Lines 69-77 require fresh project output and temp leaves, and lines 91-97 invoke the patched UI path directly under strace. No literal Docker/Podman/OCI command is present in the reviewed runner.
Lines 78-81 block graph execution when the pre-ledger subprocess fails or differs from admitted ledger SHA.

must_fix.finding: Runner requires soong/build.ninja. R4 config.go:1758-1765 chooses soong/build.<TARGET_PRODUCT><coverage>.ninja after product resolution, so a successful aosp_arm64 run can be falsely marked failed.
must_fix.required_change: Derive the exact expected filename from the fixed product/configuration, verify the resulting path and nonempty Android.bp.list, and keep generated-action status separate from target compilation.

must_fix.finding: subprocess.run timeout terminates the immediate strace process; traced build descendants may survive and keep running/writing while post-guard and RESULT proceed.
must_fix.required_change: Start a fresh process group, terminate and reap the whole group on timeout or exception, verify no descendants remain, and only then take post guards. Bound and type-check timeout_seconds.

must_fix.finding: The generator checks tracked Git state and missing tracked paths, not new untracked files or root files outside repositories. It hardcodes /data/source/aosp-16.0.0-r4 independently of packet source_checkout; equal TSV hashes could validate one tree while graph runs in another. No source immutability is enforced while the graph runs.
must_fix.required_change: Require source_checkout to resolve to the registered R4 alias target; add an exact pre/post untracked inventory for every present project and root linkfile/entry topology, including changed content hashes for any preexisting untracked files. Enforce read-only shared-source access through the execution identity or an equivalent non-container host permission boundary; do not claim source unchanged solely from tracked ledger equality.

must_fix.finding: Packet-supplied binary path/hash, source index path/hash, ledger hash, project root and output paths are only compared with themselves. The runner does not anchor to accepted patched UI SHA 92d62e59e154846535684d339657b7305ad7186aaa795bfee89a81b500901624, admitted ledger SHA, registered source/project roots, original claim/nonce, or a consumed one-shot state. Project could also be an ancestor of source because line 67 checks only one containment direction.
must_fix.required_change: Verify the packet against an independently sealed owner gate or fixed admitted identities and exact registered roots; check source/project disjointness both ways; atomically reserve a unique claim/nonce before run and prevent a second output leaf replay.

must_fix.finding: Forbidden names omit unshare, bwrap/bubblewrap, systemd-nspawn and other namespace launchers; strace captures execve only, not execveat or direct namespace syscalls. Missing or empty trace is accepted by the graph_pass expression if other checks pass. It does not prove the exact patched UI executable was observed.
must_fix.required_change: Expand the forbidden route policy, trace relevant execveat/namespace operations or equivalent, fail closed on missing/incomplete trace, and verify the observed UI exec path and hash. Audit generated Ninja actions separately before any target build.

must_fix.finding: The inherited environment retains unbounded build-affecting variables, and only a few are cleared. Exceptions after launch (including post-guard timeout, trace decode, invalid timeout type or file errors) can exit without a terminal RESULT or proven descendant cleanup; source index and binary are hashed only pre-run.
must_fix.required_change: Use a documented allowlisted environment with exact output/temp/product bindings; record its hash. Wrap run/post-guard in fail-closed finally logic that always emits an attempted-run receipt, rechecks UI/index hashes, and distinguishes graph rc, trace completeness, source state and receipt failure.

read_only_untracked_probe.method: Live gz02 git ls-files --others -z on all 1011 present repos, without --exclude-standard; lstat each returned path. This includes ignored files if any.
read_only_untracked_probe.hash_feasibility: Pre/post byte hashing of repo untracked files is cheap at the observed zero-file baseline. Hashing the old root out directory bytewise would reread about 115 GB and is not a bounded graph guard; it must be explicitly excluded from the graph input and protected from writes, while its existence/prune marker and root topology are checked.

evidence_boundary: Even after fixes, a successful one-shot command and generated Soong Ninja file prove only a host-native graph step. --skip-ninja does not run target Bionic compilation; generated actions may still contain nsjail until separately audited. No runtime or device acceptance follows.
